digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport port
propositions: The DC transport is missing twelve methods required by the core reconciler, causing crashes on `set_entity_property` and silent degradation on seven others whose call sites swallow exceptions

Seven of the twelve missing members have call sites that swallow all exceptions, meaning absent methods produce silent no-ops rather than AttributeError—fixing only the crash would leave the capability broken while appearing to work
The port contract (TicketTransport) is incomplete and not runtime-checkable, so isinstance conformance checks raise TypeError and cannot guard against missing members at construction
DC reporters require `name` field in the identity mapping but `inbound_fields._identity_of` reads only `accountId`, causing reporter mutations to re-emit on every pass even after successful writes
`get_parent_map` must use DC REST v2 offset pagination (POST /rest/api/2/search with startAt/maxResults) rather than Cloud's v3 cursor endpoint which rejects startAt with HTTP 400
Epic parents on DC require the Greenhopper API endpoint `add_issues_to_epic` with `agile_rest_path='greenhopper'` instead of the default `'agile'`, which would hit a non-existent path
